title: dactylorhiza × koningweeniana
intro: Dactylorhiza × koningweeniana, commonly known as the Konings-Koning Orchid, is a hybrid orchid plant species resulting from the cross between Dactylorhiza maculata and Dactylorhiza fuchsii. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × koningweeniana include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and aid in the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
